messages:
alex: Heads up — timeline slid ~3 weeks after infra capacity change. We need an emergency trim for the MVP by EOD. Proposing we keep core API, embeddings, and policy checks. Drop live-preview, advanced analytics, and multitenant billing for public launch.

maria: Agree with trimming live-preview — that’s a big frontend + backend piece. Multitenant billing touches tenant isolation and PG schema, estimates ~10 dev days. Not safe for this window.

sam: Design + PM note: Live-preview removal means onboarding flow needs a fallback. I can drop the preview screens and add a smaller “examples” panel instead. Low effort.

jordan: FYI sales — two pilots asked specifically for multitenant billing. We can offer them a private pilot if needed, but public launch can wait. Customer ask logged: ACME, Pilot request.

katie: Quick prioritization matrix: customer-impact / effort / risk. My cuts proposal: 1) remove live-preview (effort medium, risk low), 2) postpone admin roles and advanced analytics (effort medium, risk medium), 3) defer multitenant billing to Dedicated/private rollout (effort high, risk high).

olivia (CS): For customers asking billing, offer a short-term manual billing workflow + status page update. That buys time and keeps them calm. I can draft comms. :+1:

maria: Rough dev plan if we accept cuts: move embeddings infra to stable branch, freeze new schema changes, implement fallback onboarding, remove preview endpoints. I can get a patch timeline: 5d embeddings stab, 3d preview removal, 2d smoke/QA.

alex: Sounds reasonable. Decision proposal: freeze all new schema migrations, cut live-preview & analytics from MVP, keep multitenant billing in backlog for Dedicated pilot. Canary with internal + ACME + one more pilot.

katie: Acceptance criteria for MVP (short):
- API: auth + generate + embed work under SLOs
- Policy checks run and have regression tests
- Onboarding shows examples (no live preview)
- Docs updated for removed features

sam: UX action: I’ll ship examples panel by Tue, add callouts for features “coming soon”.

maria: I’ll create a short PR list and label them `mvp-trim`. Can someone from QA confirm capacity for quick smoke tests?

olivia (CS): QA: we can run smoke with pilot customers next Fri. I’ll coordinate.

jordan: Sales: will reach out to ACME and the other pilot to confirm they’re OK with pilot-only billing.

alex: Final call — doing it. Can we lock scope and update roadmap? If yes, say :thumbsup:

maria: :thumbsup:

sam: :thumbsup:

katie: :thumbsup:

jordan: :thumbsup: will follow up with customers

olivia (CS): :thumbsup: will draft comms

deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled: 2024-06-10 09:00 -> 2024-06-12 09:00 UTC. Rollout policy: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h.

alex: Putting checklist in thread for ops:```
Release freeze checklist:
- Keep: core API (auth, generate), embeddings, policy checks
- Remove from MVP: live-preview, advanced analytics, multitenant billing, admin-roles
- Freeze DB schema migrations until patch branch is validated
- Canary: internal + ACME + 1 pilot on 2024-06-10
- Rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h, rollback hook enabled
- Docs: update changelog + public FAQ about deferred features
```

alex: I’ll update the roadmap doc and pin the `mvp-trim` labels. Thanks everyone — aiming to ship trimmed MVP in next two weeks.

maria: I’ll post PRs and link them here.

sam: I’ll upload the new UX mocks and link in the PR.

olivia (CS): I’ll prepare the pilot comms and QA checklist.
